title: Hex
description: Abbey Road saved as a real 32 by 32 bitmap and laid open as a green hex dump. Hover any byte and the pixel it paints lights up on the cover; click one and type, in hex or plain words, and the picture changes at exactly that spot.
intent: Make the bytes under an image touchable: an uncompressed 24-bit BMP, header and all, so every byte maps to exactly one colour channel of one pixel, and editing the file is editing the picture.
sources: herb reference board: fa23bcd4 Y2K montage (hex dump on a handheld screen, green terminal text)
